text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited at all times on the north and south sides of Soudan Avenue, between Yonge Street and Holly Street. This is in response to complaints about vehicles parking in the existing "No Parking Anytime" areas and creating congestion and traffic flow concerns on this section of Soudan Avenue. This will discourage illegal parking and not allow parking by vehicles with accessible permits. This proposal will not result in the loss of any parking spaces on Soudan Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times, on the north side of Soudan Avenue, between Yonge Street and a point 38 metres east of Yonge Street. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the north side of Soudan Avenue, between a point 38 metres east of Yonge Street and Holly Street. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the south side of Soudan Avenue, between Yonge Street and Brownlow Avenue. 4. Authorized stopping prohibition to be in effect at all times, on the north side of Soudan Avenue, between Yonge Street and Holly Street. 5. Authorized stopping prohibition to be in effect at all times, on the south side of Soudan Avenue, between Yonge Street and Holly Street. 6.
